evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition frames intelligence as a property relation with proportionate stakes — a cost/benefit distinction between what you keep and what you borrow.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Calling perspective an 'asset you keep' performs proportionality — valuing one thing as retained capital against another framed as disposable commodity.

mints.name: OwnershipAsRelationalStake
mints.title: the asset you keep
mints.frame: Is the expression performing a relational hierarchy between what is owned and what is rented, framing the difference as a stake you retain versus a cost you absorb?
